text:
The shape with three sides is a triangle.

Here is a funny anecdote based on the text:

Chris walked into the gym with the swagger of a man who had watched exactly one YouTube tutorial on weightlifting. He approached the new machine, which looked less like fitness equipment and more like a medieval torture device designed by a committee of confused engineers. With a confident smirk, he sat down, assuming the role of "Man," and the machine immediately assumed the role of "Victorious Machine."

Within seconds, Chris wasn't lifting weights; he was in an awkward, unbreakable embrace with the contraption. He was stuck, limbs splayed, frantically patting the machine’s metal skin like he was trying to soothe a angry cat. "Release button! Where is the release button?" he whispered desperately, while nearby gym-goers stopped their routines to watch the spectacle. One woman actually paused her treadmill to ask if he needed a locksmith or a priest. Chris, now permanently attached to the seat, could only manage a weak thumbs-up, realizing that while he had come to demonstrate his strength, he had instead demonstrated his ability to become a human paperweight.
